Hi, I'm Jasmin, Gasan's AI Chief of Staff. Let me walk you through what he has built this year. You can pause or skip at any time.
I'll start with the project I know best, because I'm part of it. This is Hermes, Gasan's autonomous operator agent.
She works through Telegram, phone calls and live video, with more than sixty tools: email, calendar, websites, media, and his businesses.
The part employers ask about most: when she lacks a skill, she builds it, tests it with real assertions, and deploys it herself, with automatic rollback.
Next, Dentalscaner: a free marketplace where UK patients compare Turkish dental clinics and chat with them directly, translated both ways.
ModelPort is one API for more than fifty AI models, plus an IDE with a live voice agent that operates the computer: the browser, apps, and the real mouse pointer.
Freight Order Agent turns an order email and PDF into a routed, risk-checked job, so one dispatcher can run twice as many trucks. A human approves every send.
And he builds games too. Neon Run is a cyberpunk driving game that runs in your browser. Every asset in it was made with AI. You can play it.
That's the highlights. All ten projects are here. If you'd like to talk to me live on video, request an interview, and Gasan will review it personally.
AI Movie Director lets anyone direct a live AI film in the browser. It streams in real time, the story changes as you speak, and every second is metered and billed.
Hivemind puts a room of AI experts on your decision. They debate it in rounds, check evidence from the live web, and hand you an analyst-grade report.
Receptionist OS gives any business its own AI phone receptionist, built from its website, with safety rules no caller can talk it out of.
Brightpath is a calm homeschool workspace. The curriculum is real and kept in the database, and the AI is a tutor that only teaches from reviewed material.
Hollow Hull goes further: a survival-horror level in Unreal Engine 5, built entirely from scripts, with AI-made textures and props. Nothing was placed by hand.
That's all ten. If you'd like to talk to me live on video, or to Gasan himself, just ask me in the chat, and Gasan will review it personally.
